intro: Shaoshu Yang · Zhe Kong · Feng Gao · Meng Cheng · Xiangyu Liu · Yong Zhang✉ · Zhuoliang Kang
requirements: If you want run with very low VRAM, set --numpersistentparamindit 0:

steps.title: 1. Create a conda environment and install pytorch, xformers
steps.code:
conda create -n multitalk python=3.10
conda activate multitalk
pip install torch==2.4.1 torchvision==0.19.1 torchaudio==2.4.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install -U xformers==0.0.28 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121

steps.title: 2. Flash-attn installation:
steps.code:
pip install misaki[en]
pip install ninja 
pip install psutil 
pip install packaging
pip install wheel
pip install flash_attn==2.7.4.post1

steps.title: 3. Other dependencies
steps.code:
pip install -r requirements.txt
conda install -c conda-forge librosa

steps.title: 4. FFmeg installation
steps.code:
conda install -c conda-forge ffmpeg

sudo yum install ffmpeg ffmpeg-devel

zh.what: 面向“无限时长”的说话视频生成模型：输入一张人物图和一段音频，或者一段已有视频，输出口型、表情与音频对齐的说话片段，并支持把多段结果拼成任意长度而不明显崩坏。它针对的是长视频生成里身份漂移、口型逐渐失准的老问题，走的是分段生成再保持一致的路线。Python 实现，属于数字人方向偏研究型的开源项目，要自己配环境、下载权重、按脚本跑，不是网页上点两下就能出片的工具。

steps.title: 建环境
steps.desc: 用 conda 建 Python 3.10 环境，装基础依赖。
steps.code:
conda create -n multitalk python=3.10
conda activate multitalk
pip install torch==2.4.1 torchvision==0.19.1 torchaudio==2.4.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install -U xformers==0.0.28 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121

steps.title: 装项目依赖
steps.desc: 按 requirements 安装，flash-attn 需要单独处理。
steps.code:
pip install -r requirements.txt
conda install -c conda-forge librosa

steps.title: 装 ffmpeg
steps.desc: 音视频合成依赖 ffmpeg，用 conda 装最省事。
steps.code:
conda install -c conda-forge ffmpeg

sudo yum install ffmpeg ffmpeg-devel
